extracted.name: Easy Mango Banana Smoothie
extracted.description: This fresh mango banana smoothie made with milk and vanilla yogurt makes a quick, easy, and deliciously creamy breakfast or mid-afternoon snack.
instruction_lines: Combine mangos, banana, vanilla yogurt, and milk in a blender; blend until smooth.
